name: Clean Room Environment Controller
description: Wafer fab clean room monitoring — temperature, humidity, particle count, differential pressure, HEPA status

operations.name: read_temperature
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov al, 0x00
out 0x43, al
in al, 0x40
movzx eax, al
in al, 0x40
movzx ecx, al
shl ecx, 8
or eax, ecx
xor edx, edx
mov ecx, 3276
div ecx
add eax, 2090
ret

operations.name: read_humidity
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov al, 0x00
out 0x43, al
in al, 0x40
movzx eax, al
in al, 0x40
movzx ecx, al
shl ecx, 8
or eax, ecx
xor edx, edx
mov ecx, 6553
div ecx
add eax, 4200
ret

operations.name: read_particle_count
operations.desc: Read airborne particle count per cubic meter (Class 100 clean room, target < 100)
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov al, 0x00
out 0x43, al
in al, 0x40
movzx eax, al
in al, 0x40
movzx ecx, al
shl ecx, 8
or eax, ecx
xor edx, edx
mov ecx, 546
div ecx
add eax, 20
ret
operations.returns: Particle count in EAX (range 20-140, alert if > 100)

operations.name: read_pressure_diff
operations.desc: Read differential pressure between clean room and outside (target: +12.5 Pa)
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov al, 0x00
out 0x43, al
in al, 0x40
movzx eax, al
in al, 0x40
movzx ecx, al
shl ecx, 8
or eax, ecx
xor edx, edx
mov ecx, 13107
div ecx
add eax, 1100
ret

operations.name: read_hepa_status
operations.desc: Read HEPA filter differential pressure (0=OK, >500=replace needed)
operations.asm:
BITS 32
mov al, 0x00
out 0x43, al
in al, 0x40
movzx eax, al
in al, 0x40
movzx ecx, al
shl ecx, 8
or eax, ecx
xor edx, edx
mov ecx, 65
div ecx
add eax, 200
ret
operations.returns: HEPA pressure drop in Pa (range 200-1200, replace if > 500)
